chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who bequeathed to some of his heirs that he owed him a debt. He said: “If the deceased was acceptable/reliable, then give him that which he bequeathed for him.”

key_terms.أَوْصَى: made a bequest or formal testamentary statement
key_terms.الَّذِي أَوْصَى لَهُ: that which was assigned or stated for him in the bequest
key_terms.مَرْضِيًّا: trustworthy or accepted in character and reliability

ai.seo_question: Is a deceased person’s acknowledgment of debt to one of his heirs accepted in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person’s acknowledgment of a debt in favor of one of his heirs. If the deceased was regarded as trustworthy, his statement is accepted and the specified amount is to be given accordingly.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5542 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:

'I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who, in his will, acknowledged a debt to one of his heirs.'
Imam (as) said: "If the deceased was in a sound state of health, then give him what was bequeathed to him."
